meaning:
τάφος, -ου, ὁ
(θάντω), [in LXX chiefly for קֶבֶר ;]
1. a burial (Hom., al.).
2. a grave, tomb (Res., Hdt., al.): Mat.23:27, 29 27:61, 64 27:66 28:1, Rom.3:13" (LXX) .†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones…
“Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
